internal_correlation_id.construction: HarnessRunner builds ModelRequest.correlation_id deterministically from task_digest prefix and call index; ModelResponse copies it back

provider_request_binding.evidence: OpenAiModelGateway serializes model/instructions/input/max_output_tokens/store only; HTTP headers are bearer auth and content-type; ModelRequest.correlation_id is not serialized into the request body or provider idempotency/request header

gateway_test_scope.evidence: tests construct correlation_id but exercise response parsing, error mapping, model identity and budget behavior; no server assertion binds the provider request to correlation_id/idempotency

observed.crash_retry_consequence: The stable AegisEvo logical evaluation job can be reclaimed after lease expiry, but a remote model call has no inspected provider-visible idempotency key tied to that logical job/call. A successful provider call followed by worker death before durable observation completion can therefore be physically repeated.
observed.scope_guard: This is an exact finding for the inspected OpenAiModelGateway revision. It does not prove every possible custom ModelGateway lacks provider idempotency.

design_rule: An internal correlation_id that survives in local response metadata is observability, not exactly-once semantics, unless it is durably bound to the logical evaluation and transmitted/validated as provider idempotency or reconciled against an independent provider receipt.
minimum_provider_binding: derive stable provider_call_id from logical_evaluation_id + immutable call index/input digest
persist PREPARED provider effect before network dispatch
send provider-supported idempotency key/request identity when semantics support it
bind returned provider request/response receipt to provider_call_id and input digest
on timeout/crash, reconcile receipt/request identity before any retry
if provider cannot establish happened/not-happened, retain UNKNOWN and fail closed rather than issuing a fresh uncharged logical call
keep query/statistical consumption charged to the logical evaluation regardless of physical retry outcome
falsification_test: Wrap the gateway with a test provider that durably counts distinct provider-side executions. SIGKILL the worker after provider success but before complete_job, expire/reclaim the job, and resume. Current inspected path predicts >1 provider execution for one logical job. A repaired path must show exactly one provider-side effect or an UNKNOWN fail-closed state, never an uncharged duplicate.
